    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','last_heartbeat_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs','error_message'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events','workflow_run_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events','event_type'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events','event_payload_json'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events','created_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','workflow_run_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','step_name'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','status'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','input_hash'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','output_hash'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','started_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs','completed_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_locks','lock_key'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_locks','workflow_run_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_locks','status'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_locks','expires_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_locks','last_heartbeat_at')
),
existing AS (
  SELECT table_name, column_name
  FROM information_schema.columns
  WHERE table_schema = current_schema()
    AND table_name IN (
      'moex_n8n_workflow_runs',
      'moex_n8n_workflow_run_events',
      'moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs',
      'moex_n8n_workflow_locks'
    )
),
missing AS (
  SELECT r.table_name, r.column_name
  FROM required r
  LEFT JOIN existing e
    ON e.table_name = r.table_name
   AND e.column_name = r.column_name
  WHERE e.column_name IS NULL
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'ok', NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM missing),
  'missing_columns', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table', table_name, 'column', column_name)) FROM missing), '[]'::jsonb),
  'input', (SELECT j FROM input)
) AS result;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS j
),
eligible_states(state_name) AS (
  VALUES
    ('github_execution_requested'),
    ('github_executor_pr_opened_waiting_ci'),
    ('github_execution_retry_wait')
),
terminal_states(state_name) AS (
  VALUES
    ('ci_passed'),
    ('ci_failed'),
    ('manual_review_required'),
    ('github_executor_ci_passed_pm_l3_validation_pending'),
    ('github_executor_ci_failed_pm_l3_validation_pending')
),
candidate_runs AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT to_jsonb(r) AS row_json, r.workflow_run_id
  FROM moex_n8n_workflow_runs r
  WHERE COALESCE(r.current_state, '') IN (SELECT state_name FROM eligible_states)
    AND COALESCE(r.current_state, '') NOT IN (SELECT state_name FROM terminal_states)
    AND (
      r.status <> 'processing'
      OR r.lock_expires_at IS NULL
      OR r.lock_expires_at <= now()
    )
  ORDER BY r.last_heartbeat_at DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 200
),
candidate_events AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(e) AS row_json
  FROM moex_n8n_workflow_run_events e
  JOIN candidate_runs r
    ON r.workflow_run_id = e.workflow_run_id
  ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 200
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'input', (SELECT j FROM input),
  'events', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(row_json) FROM candidate_events), '[]'::jsonb),
  'runs', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(row_json) FROM candidate_runs), '[]'::jsonb),
  'eligible_states', (SELECT jsonb_agg(state_name) FROM eligible_states),
  'terminal_states', (SELECT jsonb_agg(state_name) FROM terminal_states)
) AS result;

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS j
),
lock_attempt AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('moex_route_b_github_branch_pr_executor_v1')::bigint) AS lock_acquired
),
claimed AS (
  UPDATE moex_n8n_workflow_runs r
  SET status = 'processing',
      current_state = 'github_executor_claimed',
      current_phase = 'github_branch_pr_executor',
      worker_execution_id = (SELECT j->>'executor_run_id' FROM input),
      claim_token = (SELECT j->>'claim_token' FROM input),
      locked_by = 'MOEX_ROUTE_B_GITHUB_BRANCH_PR_EXECUTOR_V1_10_3',
      lock_expires_at = now() + interval '20 minutes',
      last_heartbeat_at = now(),
      error_message = NULL
  FROM input, lock_attempt
  WHERE lock_attempt.lock_acquired
    AND r.workflow_run_id = input.j->>'workflow_run_id'
    AND COALESCE(r.current_state, '') IN (
      'github_execution_requested',
      'github_executor_pr_opened_waiting_ci',
      'github_execution_retry_wait'
    )
    AND (
      r.status <> 'processing'
      OR r.lock_expires_at IS NULL
      OR r.lock_expires_at <= now()
    )
  RETURNING to_jsonb(r) AS row_json
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'input', (SELECT j FROM input),
  'lock_acquired', (SELECT lock_acquired FROM lock_attempt),
  'claimed', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claimed),
  'claimed_row', (SELECT row_json FROM claimed LIMIT 1)
) AS result;

  SELECT r.workflow_run_id, r.current_state AS previous_state
  FROM moex_n8n_workflow_runs r, payload
  WHERE r.workflow_run_id = payload.p->>'workflow_run_id'
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE moex_n8n_workflow_runs r
  SET status = payload.p->>'status',
      current_state = payload.p->>'current_state',
      current_phase = COALESCE(payload.p->>'current_phase', 'github_branch_pr_executor'),
      last_heartbeat_at = now(),
      lock_expires_at = NULL,
      locked_by = NULL,
      worker_execution_id = NULL,
      claim_token = NULL,
      error_message = COALESCE(
        payload.p #>> '{execution_result,error,message}',
        payload.p #>> '{execution_result,error,code}',
        payload.p #>> '{error,message}',
        payload.p #>> '{error,code}'
      )
  FROM payload
  WHERE r.workflow_run_id = payload.p->>'workflow_run_id'
  RETURNING to_jsonb(r) AS row_json
),
insert_event AS (
  INSERT INTO moex_n8n_workflow_run_events (
    workflow_run_id,
    previous_state,
    new_state,
    event_type,
    event_payload_json,
    created_at
  )
  SELECT
    payload.p->>'workflow_run_id',
    (SELECT previous_state FROM previous_row LIMIT 1),
    payload.p->>'current_state',
    COALESCE(payload.p->>'event_type', 'route_b_github_executor_result'),
    payload.p,
    now()
  FROM payload
  RETURNING workflow_run_id
),
insert_step AS (
  INSERT INTO moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs (
    workflow_run_id,
    step_name,
    status,
    input_hash,
    output_hash,
    started_at,
    completed_at
  )
  SELECT
    payload.p->>'workflow_run_id',
    'github_branch_pr_executor',
    payload.p->>'status',
    md5(COALESCE((payload.p->'request')::text, payload.p->>'request_id', '')),
    md5(payload.p::text),
    now(),
    now()
  FROM payload
  ON CONFLICT (workflow_run_id, step_name)
  DO UPDATE SET
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    input_hash = EXCLUDED.input_hash,
    output_hash = EXCLUDED.output_hash,
    completed_at = EXCLUDED.completed_at
  RETURNING workflow_run_id
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'persisted', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated),
  'event_inserted', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM insert_event),
  'step_inserted', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM insert_step),
  'workflow_run_id', (SELECT p->>'workflow_run_id' FROM payload),
  'status', (SELECT p->>'status' FROM payload),
  'current_state', (SELECT p->>'current_state' FROM payload),
  'event_type', (SELECT COALESCE(p->>'event_type', 'route_b_github_executor_result') FROM payload),
  'payload', (SELECT p FROM payload)
) AS result;
